title: Can the service contain this failure?
description: Inject one failure and tune placement, capacity, deadlines, and request handling. The result separates surviving pods from the user-visible request envelope.

scenarios.label: One pod crashes
scenarios.detail: A ready instance exits and replacement takes 45 seconds.

scenarios.label: One zone disappears
scenarios.detail: All replicas placed in one failure domain become unavailable for eight minutes.

scenarios.label: Dependency slows down
scenarios.detail: A required downstream call takes 1.8 seconds and ties up caller concurrency.

handling.label: Immediate caller retries
handling.detail: Failed requests retry without a shared budget, increasing pressure during overload.

handling.label: Bounded queue and retry budget
handling.detail: Admit limited work, shed excess load, and retry only within the end-to-end deadline.
